text:
Anya: dropped a compact mock for the min/max row + SLO slider with a new label set: https://figma.link/spike-boost-v1 — asking for copy takes and a11y quick wins. TL;DR: two floor modes, a "spike boost" CTA, inline cost, and SLO guardrail hints. Bren: first impression: love the simplified row. Copy thought: "Reserve floor" (guaranteed) vs "Elastic floor" (allows scaler to go lower). Short labels scan well. Ibrahim: accessibility: tab order needs to be stepper -> SLO slider -> spike CTA. Right now SLO is first. Also add aria-describedby from stepper -> guardrail text. Sophie: microcopy: 'spike boost' sounds fine. alternatives: 'Peak boost', 'Temporary top-up'. My vote: 'Spike boost' — concise and less technical than 'burst'. :+1: Mateo: billing clarity: show projected per-hour and per-peak-minute note: e.g., "+1 GPU ≈ $0.60 / hr (billed per GPU-minute)". Add a tiny 'how billed' link. Anya: UX edge: when Reserve floor > Max, show inline helper: "Reserve floor cannot exceed Max capacity" + action 'Swap values' and 'Set Max to X'. Keep tone neutral. Bren: visual note: on small widths show condensed "2 ▸ 8" and reveal full text on focus. Keyboard users should get a tooltip with full labels. Ibrahim: ARIA snippet suggestion: ``` 2 GPUs (Reserve floor)
Estimate: $1.20 / hr
``` Use role=status for cost updates and role=alert for validation. Debounce cost updates 250ms. Sophie: color contrast: spike CTA teal on light fails on some themes. Try #005f57 for filled CTA or outline variant with 3px focus ring. I'll run contrast checks. Mateo: pool interaction: if selected pool disallows spike boost (preemptible-only), disable CTA and show tooltip: 'Spike boost unavailable for selected pool'. Also provide 'Choose compatible pool' quick link. A11yBot: checklist appended: tab order, aria-describedby linking steppers and guardrails, role/status for estimates, debounce 250ms, contrast >=4.5:1, tooltip length <120 chars, focusable helper action. Anya: decision recap: use 'Reserve floor' / 'Elastic floor' labels, CTA 'Spike boost', inline billing hint, condensed numeric for narrow screens, aria role/status + debounce, and pool availability state. I'll update Figma and post new frame by EOD. anyone object? Bren: no objections. Ibrahim: will prototype tab order and aria-describedby tomorrow. Sophie: will share hex suggestions after contrast run. Mateo: will add billing hint route and API flag 'billing_hint=gpu_minute'. Anya: thanks all — will follow up with updated link. :rocket:
